about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I am a hands-on senior backend engineer and technical lead with an M.Sc. in Computer Science from Amirkabir University of Technology. My work spans distributed backend systems, real-time media, platform engineering, and Linux.
about.paragraph2: The strongest part of my work sits where architecture and implementation meet: defining service boundaries, making trade-offs explicit, and designing for failure before systems scale. I have led small engineering teams while continuing to contribute directly to production code.
about.paragraph3: I am currently focused on senior backend, platform, and technical-lead roles in the EU, with employer-supported relocation to Germany or the Netherlands and selected remote engineering or architecture engagements.

projects.title: Projects

1.name: Award-Winning AI Hologram Project
1.description: Designed the AI backend for a real-time hologram installation: camera feed → pose estimation pipeline → WebSocket projection control, all under 80ms end-to-end. Demonstrated at ITEX 2024, winning Best Booth against 200+ exhibitors.

2.name: Digital Investment Management Dashboard
2.description: Architected and coded the heavy computational logic for a data-intensive investor dashboard, providing real-time analytics and portfolio management features for Capitalino's clients.

3.name: Crypto-to-Fiat Payment Gateway
3.description: Architected and deployed a crypto-to-fiat gateway integrating blockchain transactions with fiat payment workflows. Designed secure backend services, transaction state handling, and the supporting operational infrastructure.

4.name: Financial Trading Gamification Platform
4.description: Engineered and launched a competitive gamification platform for financial trading simulations. The platform debuted at the Shiraz ITEX 2023 international exhibition to drive user engagement and demonstrate real-time data handling capabilities.

5.name: Secure Over-the-Air (OTA) Update System
5.description: Built an atomic OTA update system for 5,000+ IoT edge devices: delta compression, rollback on checksum failure, A/B partition switching. Reduced kernel boot time by 40% via PREEMPT_RT tuning and eliminating unnecessary initrd stages.

6.name: GreedyLearner: Gamified Algorithm Tutor
6.description: Developed as my Master's thesis, 'GreedyLearner' is an Android application that gamifies complex computer science algorithms to improve student motivation and learning outcomes through a guided discovery approach. The app was successfully published on app stores.

7.name: P2P Cryptocurrency Trading Platform
7.description: Architected and built a complete Peer-to-Peer cryptocurrency trading platform from the ground up. A key feature was the implementation of atomic transactions in MongoDB to guarantee financial data integrity, along with secure integration with the Ethereum blockchain via Web3.js.

8.name: Blockchain-Based Virtual Coin System
8.description: Developed a permissioned blockchain reward system on Hyperledger Sawtooth as part of the university Blockchain Committee. Users earned tokens from verified real-world actions, settled via a Node.js REST gateway with idempotency guarantees.

personal.title: Distributed systems, real-time media, and backend platforms.

personal.about:
I am a hands-on senior backend engineer and technical lead with 10+ years across distributed systems, real-time media, fintech, and embedded Linux. I work with Node.js, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, NATS JetStream, WebRTC, LiveKit, and Linux.

My strongest work sits where architecture and implementation meet: defining ownership, failure modes, consistency requirements, and operational constraints before scaling the system. I have led engineering teams while continuing to contribute directly to production code.

I am currently targeting senior backend, platform, and technical-lead roles in the EU, with employer-supported relocation to Germany or the Netherlands and selected remote engineering or architecture engagements.

1.title: Solutions Architect
1.tech: WebRTC (LiveKit), delayed HLS playback, NATS JetStream, Go
description: Architected live WebRTC delivery for 5,000+ concurrent users at platform level.
Used NATS JetStream and Go for application coordination; delayed HLS playback was available hours after the live session, not as a current-session fallback.

2.title: Head of Software & AI Development
2.tech: Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Docker Swarm, Python (AI)
description: Led a 4-person team in building and deploying a crypto-to-fiat payment gateway.
Winner of Best Booth at ITEX 2024 for the AI Hologram Project.

3.title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Worked on P2P order matching and idempotent ledger semantics.
Implemented ACID-compliant ledgers for high-frequency trading.

4.title: Systems Engineer (Embedded Linux)
description: Designed atomic OTA update pipelines for an IoT device fleet.
Built Yocto-based custom Linux images with PREEMPT_RT patches for hard real-time sensor processing.

5.title: Android Systems Developer
description: Developed native C++ modules for GPS sensor fusion.
